sections.text: NO! I Want My Ice Cream Back!!!

-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 40% for 120 seconds.
All stats reduction effect boosted by 10% for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies (NPCs). Decreases action speed by 60 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Cost recovery speed reduced by 10 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Heals 40% of max HP every 5 seconds for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Heals CP by 10% of all alliesmax CP every 5 seconds for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical/magic damage taken to 0 (7 times). Effect applied for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Disaster Collapse (reduces action speed by 30, reduces Cost recovery speed by 10, extends cooldown times by 30%, and reduces status ailment resistance by 30) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
